lead.message: We process around 200 shipment booking emails a week by hand and retype them into our TMS. We want an n8n workflow that reads the emails, extracts the booking fields and creates the shipment through the TMS API. We would like to start next month.

Our showroom uses Typeform and Calendly for inquiries but leads are copied into Pipedrive manually and often lost. We need both connected to Pipedrive with deal owners assigned by region. Our goal is to have this live within six weeks.

We want an internal assistant that answers advisers' questions from our 300-page compliance handbook and cites the section. It must run on our own servers. We have budget approved for this quarter and want a proposal this month.

We are moving 40,000 customer and order records from an old Access database to HubSpot. We need the data cleaned, duplicates merged and the import validated. The old system is switched off on 31 January, so the migration must finish before then.

Our three clinics book appointments by phone and WhatsApp, and reminders are sent by hand. We want automatic appointment reminders and a daily no-show report from our booking system's API. We hope to start in the next two to three weeks.

We get tender invitations by email and track them in a spreadsheet. We want them logged in Salesforce automatically with the deadline, value and documents attached, plus a weekly summary to the bid team. We need this before our busy season in March.

We answer the same student questions about courses, prices and schedules dozens of times a day. We would like an AI assistant on our website that answers from our course catalogue and hands over to staff when it is unsure. Ideally live before the spring enrolment.

Our Shopify store's returns are handled through email and a shared sheet. We need a returns workflow: customer form, label creation via our courier's API, stock update and a refund task for finance. Timeline: within the next month.

We run an architecture studio and want website inquiries, Instagram messages and email inquiries collected in one CRM pipeline with automatic follow-up tasks. We are choosing between HubSpot and Pipedrive and want it set up this quarter.

We are consolidating two CRMs after an acquisition: about 12,000 contacts in Zoho and 8,000 in HubSpot with a lot of overlap. We need deduplication rules, a validated merge into HubSpot and a rollback plan. Project should start in December.

Brokers spend hours each week re-entering quote requests from our web form into our policy system. We want the form data validated and pushed into the system's API, with a review step for incomplete requests. We would like to begin in January.

Our reception team answers booking and amenity questions by email for four hotels. We want an assistant that drafts replies from our hotel information and booking policy, which staff approve before sending. Budget is set and we want to start this month.

Service requests from our machine customers arrive by email and phone and are typed into our ticket system by hand. We want an automated intake that creates tickets with the machine serial number and urgency, and routes them to the right technician. Start in Q1.

We sell a B2B analytics product and trial sign-ups land in our database, but sales only sees them in a weekly export. We need sign-ups synced to HubSpot in real time with product usage properties so sales can follow up. We want this done within four weeks.

Patients fill in a contact form on our website and we answer by phone. We want each request saved in our CRM, a confirmation email drafted for staff to approve, and a report of unanswered requests every morning. We need it before our new clinic opens next month.

Supplier invoices arrive as PDFs by email and are keyed into Xero manually. We want them extracted, matched to purchase orders and created as draft bills in Xero for approval. We would like to start in the next few weeks.

Catering inquiries for our six restaurants come in through the website, email and phone. We want them in one place with automatic menu-and-quote follow-ups and a reminder for staff if nobody replies within a day. We are ready to start in two weeks.

Tenants email us repair requests and questions about their leases all day. We want an assistant that classifies each email, answers common questions from our tenant handbook and creates a maintenance ticket when needed. Hoping to launch in February.

We have 15 years of customer and order history in Excel files and an old ERP. We want it cleaned and migrated into Odoo CRM with duplicates removed and a validation report. The new system goes live on 1 March, so we need to start soon.

Support tickets in Zendesk and accounts in HubSpot are not connected, so account managers miss escalations. We need ticket summaries and escalation flags synced to the HubSpot company record. We want this running within the next six weeks.

Course applications come in through Google Forms and we email each applicant manually. We want an automated flow that scores completeness, sends confirmation emails, and creates a record in Airtable for the admissions team. Applications open in January.

Could you send pricing for connecting our booking website to HubSpot? We need every booking inquiry created as a contact and deal, with a follow-up task for group bookings. We want it working before the season starts in April.

What would it cost to automate our wholesale order intake? Cafés email orders and we type them into our ERP. We want the emails parsed, orders created through the ERP API, and exceptions sent to a person. We plan to start next month.

We would like a quote for a private document assistant that answers lawyers' questions from our internal templates and precedents, running on our own server. We have a budget for this in the current quarter and want to begin within a month.
